info: Keep logging food in Lose It! This screen reads available Health Connect nutrition alongside any food already logged in Pulse. Lose It! takes priority, then MyFitnessPal; other nutrition origins are fallbacks, never added on top. Expenditure is an open, experimental estimate from intake and weigh-ins, not MacroFactor’s proprietary algorithm. Fitbit activity remains a separate comparison and never adds calories to your food budget. Everything here is calculated on this phone without an AI service.
source: Keep logging in Lose It! · sync through Health Connect
referenceOnly: Reference only · set your own calorie target
calibrationNote: Needs at least 14 consecutive days of calorie logs and 7 weigh-ins spanning that interval. Missing food is never assumed to be zero.
assumption: A calorie total does not prove that every meal was logged. The model assumes complete food logs and consistent weigh-in timing. Water changes and logging errors can both change the estimate.
dayNotFinished: A daily deficit appears after the day ends, with usable intake and expenditure data.
partialHint: Exclude it from the expenditure model without changing Lose It! or Health Connect. Turn this off after correcting the original log.
chart: Logged intake versus estimated daily expenditure, seven days ending on the selected day
chartNote: Colored bars are intake; gray bars are estimated expenditure, not Fitbit burn. Intake is blue below 90% of the target, green at 90–110%, and orange above 110%. The line is your current calorie target. Today’s intake is still running. Gaps are unknown.
chartKey: Intake · gray expenditure · dashed current target
historyNote: The chart ends on the selected day. Today’s totals are still updating. Dashed line: current target. Missing values are gaps.
averagesNote: Each graph point averages usable calorie logs in the seven calendar days ending on that date. The graph ends before the selected day. Missing or reviewed incomplete days are omitted, not zero. Macro bars show each nutrient’s known-day average against your current daily target, over the selected 7 or 30 days before that day. All bars use a 0–150% scale: ticks mark the target, and an arrow marks values beyond the scale. Exact grams remain visible. Food log coverage counts days with usable calories, not days you met a target, proof that every meal was logged, or complete macro data.
macroAverageA11y: {{label}}: average {{value}} g per known day; current daily target {{target}} g.
macroMissingA11y: {{label}}: no data for this period; current daily target {{target}} g.
logCoverageA11y: {{days}} of {{span}} days with usable calorie logs, {{from}} to {{to}}. Not a count of days you met your targets or confirmation that every meal was logged.
weightHistoryNote: Dots mark weigh-in days; the line connects smoothed estimates. Missing days aren’t measurements.
weightNote: Weight uses a seven-day exponential half-life. Values and changes follow your chosen units. The trend can move with water, not just fat. After seven days without a weigh-in, its current value is withheld.
planNote: The original plan starts {{day}} and stays fixed as your estimates or calorie target change. A difference is a prompt to review water changes, activity and logs, not proof of under-reporting.
planNeeds: Needs calibration, a target and today’s weigh-in.
planRequirements: Choose your calorie target, finish calibration and record a weigh-in today to save an original plan. Future progress is compared with that fixed starting estimate.
activityNote: Coverage-limited exercise estimate · never extra food calories
hrNote: Experimental population equation, not a personal calibration. Only covered minutes of steady-state cardio at 90–150 bpm are modeled, for ages 18–45 and weights 47–120 kg. Basketball and other intermittent sports retain their minutes without an unsupported calorie estimate. This includes resting energy during the modeled minutes, not total daily expenditure or extra food allowance.
wearableNote: Health Connect’s reported total, shown for comparison only. Today’s total is incomplete.
targetHint: Match the calorie budget you use in Lose It! Blank uses the maintenance reference. Exercise never adds a bonus.
maintenanceBasis: Maintenance inferred from intake and weight; not a chosen weight-loss target
referenceBasis: 2,000 kcal food-label reference, not a personalized estimate. Set your own target.
proteinHeight: Based on a healthy weight for {{height}} {{heightUnit}} ({{weight}} {{unit}}). Log your weight to use yours.
